what.text: This page follows refugees from Vietnam living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4854 Vietnamese refugees in the United Kingdom, 23.5% of all refugees from Vietnam.
France hosts the most Vietnamese refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Germany and Thailand.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Vietnam: an interstate armed conflict with China from 1986 to 1988.
The fact pack does not give reasons why people left Vietnam in recent years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1991 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
